item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Study of multimodal communication in insects attacking cultural heritage (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

The research activity, carried out within the framework of the MUR FIS 3 – BACH project dedicated to the study of biotremology applied to cultural heritage conservation, will focus on the study of multimodal communication in the behavioral ecology of two key cultural heritage pests: Anobium punctatum and Tineola bisselliella. Specifically, the candidate will be responsible for the development and optimization of innovative, multidisciplinary experimental setups dedicated to integrating chemical and vibrational communication in reproductive and aggregation contexts. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Study of microbial populations in food and agro-environmental matrices. (Politecnica MARCHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-08 Microbiologia agraria, alimentare e ambientale

The research activity will focus on microbial populations associated with food and agro-environmental matrices using culture-dependent and -independent approaches. Main microbial groups will be quantified using conventional microbiological techniques and selective and/or differential media. Microorganisms of interest will be isolated, purified, identified, and preserved for phenotypic and functional characterization. DNA extracted directly from the matrices will be used for metataxonomic analyses targeting the 16S rRNA and ITS/26S rRNA genes. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: SUS-ATI - Sustainable use of wheat ATI diversity for healthier, low-impact food supply chains. (Politecnica MARCHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The research programme aims to investigate and valorise the genetic and functional diversity of alpha-amylase/trypsin inhibitors (ATIs) in wheat to develop healthier and more sustainable varieties and food products. The activities will include the genomic characterisation of a broad panel of *Triticum* genotypes through targeted long-read sequencing, analysis of variation at ATI loci, and integration of genomic data with information on ATI content and immunostimulatory potential. Low-ATI wheat lines will be selected and evaluated, and strategies will be developed to valorise milling by-products, such as bran and germ, through controlled fermentation with lactic acid bacteria. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The research programme aims to investigate, characterise and valorise the genetic and phenotypic diversity of plant materials of agricultural interest within the framework of the inSiEME and Root2Res projects. The activities will include the collection, organisation, analysis and integration of genetic, genomic, phenotypic and environmental data obtained from plant materials evaluated under field and/or controlled conditions. Particular attention will be given to the relationships between genetic variation, agronomically relevant traits and responses to different environments, with the aim of identifying plant materials, information and tools useful for selection and crop breeding. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: . (Politecnica MARCHE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-09 13:00
Institution: Politecnica MARCHE, Ancona
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The project involves activities related to the various stages of the strawberry breeding program, from the selection and implementation of crossing combinations to selection techniques and phenotypic evaluation of seedlings and selections obtained for yield, resistance to biotic and abiotic factors, and sensory and nutritional quality analysis. The research program also requires expertise in crop management, various phenotyping methodologies, and fruit quality control, as well as strawberry propagation techniques, including in vitro methods. Expertise in the analysis of data obtained from phenotyping and genotyping studies is also considered relevant.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Quantification of the ecosystem services provided by legume crops, with particular attention to their interaction with the spontaneous flora. (Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-27 12:00
Institution: Sc.Sup. S.Anna PISA, Pisa
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-02 Agronomia e sistemi colturali erbacei e ortofloricoli

The VALERECO and SOILRES projects aim to quantify selected ecosystem services provided by the inclusion of legume crops in a simple cereal-based rotation. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating and carrying out soil, crop, soil biological quality, and weed flora sampling during the final year of the VALERECO field trial and as part of the SOILRES project. In addition, the candidate will be responsible for completing the local databases, as well as extracting and analysing data on weed flora collected by the other project partners. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-23 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

The research activity will focus on the development of innovative and environmentally sustainable cultivation schemes aimed at accelerating plant growth and development in young olive orchards while, at the same time, enhancing their ability to withstand biotic stress. Particular attention will be paid to the ongoing effects of climate change and to the requirements associated with new high-density planting systems. The proposed cultivation schemes will also include the use of biostimulants and, where appropriate, bioactive compounds, with the aim of promoting vegetative vigour and enhancing the plants' natural defence mechanisms. Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-05 Patologia vegetale ed entomologia

Production and morphophysiological characterisation of tomato plants grown under different sodium regimes, to be used in feeding bioassays with phytophagous insects aimed at assessing the nutritional role of this element and identifying the concentrations required to ensure normal insect development, survival, and reproduction.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Next Generation Tools for Forest Habitat Restoration and Closer-to-Nature Forestry (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-27 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Legnaro
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

LIFE Next-GoProFor enhances the conservation status of Natura 2000 forest habitats by applying Closer-to-Nature Forestry (CNF) and creating tools replicable across Europe. The project operates in four Italian Living Labs (Val di Susa, Montagna Pistoiese, Monte Catria, Serra San Bruno), covering 4,700 ha of habitats in poor condition (9110, 91M0, 9210, 9260, 9340, 9420).

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-06 Genetica, chimica e pedologia agraria e forestale

The candidate will be expected to carry out controlled plant-growth experiments with crop species and model plants using hydroponic systems and rhizoboxes. The research activities will focus on investigating the reuptake and metabolic fate of root-exuded organic acids, particularly citric and malic acids, and on elucidating the physiological and molecular mechanisms underlying these processes. The work will include the design and implementation of reuptake experiments using isotopically labelled citric and malic acids in hydroponic systems and hydrogel-based approaches (e.g., DGT-based techniques). The research focuses on the assessment of biological, chemical and physical soil indicators in agricultural systems to evaluate the effects of different cover crop mixtures on soil health, functionality and quality. Particular emphasis is placed on biological parameters, including the abundance, diversity and composition of soil microbial communities, microbial activity and functional traits, as well as the diversity and abundance of soil fauna. Molecular, biochemical and ecological approaches are used to investigate bacteria, fungi, microfauna and mesofauna and their responses to different cover crop treatments. item.description:

Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-03 Scienze e tecnologie dei sistemi arborei e forestali

The research aims to enhance the sustainability and resilience of the olive and olive oil supply chain by improving its adaptation to climate change, economic competitiveness, and the quality of extra virgin olive oil. Innovative bioactive compounds will be evaluated to mitigate the effects of abiotic stresses on olive trees. To improve soil fertility, enhance carbon sequestration, increase productivity, and reduce the use of chemical inputs, the recovery and use of olive industry byproducts as soil amendments will be optimized.
